```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## 1. Load data

```{r}
league_df <- read_csv("data/laser_league_players.csv")
```

## 2. Inspect structure

```{r}
nrow(league_df)
ncol(league_df)
names(league_df)
str(league_df)
```

## 3. Grouped summary

```{r}
summary_tbl <- league_df %>%
  group_by(home_arena) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_wellbeing = mean(wellbeing_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_matches = mean(matches_played, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
summary_tbl
```
